title.narrative: Enhanced labour statistics supported by international statistical standards and reliable labour market information systems

description.narrative: With the support of ILO, Seychelles has gone through the steps of LMIS implementation. ILO started supporting LMIS implementation in Seychelles in 2022. The final workshop was conducted in May 2025. Ministry of Employment and Human Resource Planning (MEHRP) is the implementing agency for LMIS in Seychelles, strongly supported by the National Bureau of Statistics (NBS). Both entities are now preparing for the launch. The launch has been delayed by staff turnover in the MEHRP, which has had an impact on LMIS implementation. For the 2026-2027 biennium, the work under Outcome A in Seychelles, consist of the finalization of LMIS implementation process and launching of the platform. Labour Market Information System (LMIS) is an information network comprising of institutions, persons and systems that informs the formulation, design, and implementation of focused and targeted employment and labour policies in addition to monitoring and evaluation of those policies. Additionally, LMIS contributes to a reduction in the transaction costs of labour markets because it helps in overcoming the challenge of incomplete information when it comes to labour markets. A Labour Market Observatory (LMO) integrates critical information on labour markets, to inform the formulation and implementation of policies and strategies. It encompasses, among other things, a Labour Market Information System (LMIS). Incomplete information can amply be addressed through training the networks in labour markets in data production which is a key component of LMIS. The work is done in collaboration with the Ministry of Employment and Human Resource Planning (MEHRP), as the main stakeholder, supported by National Bureau of Statistics (NBS) The work will benefit all producers and users of labour market statistics.
